component.name: rox
component.summary: A desktop music player for large, carefully tagged local libraries

description.p: rox is a desktop music player for people with large, carefully tagged local libraries. It reads full tags and true durations from every file on import, watches the library folders for changes, and stays fast at tens of thousands of tracks.

The interface is panels you compose yourself: library, queue, playlists, lyrics, cover art, visualizers, and forty-odd more, each duplicated with its own settings, popped out into real windows, and saved as a workspace. A workspace is one file carrying the layout, palette, and appearance, so a look can be shared.

Tagging is deep enough to trust with a real collection: a full tag editor with atomic writes, batch edits with find and replace, ratings stored in the files themselves, online lookup through MusicBrainz and others, lyrics, and ReplayGain for the files no tagger ever measured.
